title: Amazon Burned $2M on One Broken AI Project
description:
A single broken AI project burned nearly $2M at Amazon 🔥

A Sonnet based system was matching authors to book listings, it never actually worked. Budget overshot by almost 1000% and nobody caught it for five months 😅

One exec admitted its hard to know what anything costs once AI is in the loop. Amazon is now building automatic spend caps ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
